strengths: Correctly captures CD8 lineage via CD8A/CD8B
Strongly supported by cytotoxic effector markers GZMK, GZMH, GZMA, GZMM, NKG7, GNLY, CST7, CTSW, CCL5 and cell-killing enrichments
Balances NK-like markers (NCR3, GNLY, NKG7, HCST) with CD3D/CD3G/CD2 to avoid NK misannotation
Most specific ontology-valid supported label among the three reviewers
weaknesses: Top-k includes unmapped NKT-like/effector-memory descriptors, but the core CL:0000794 label remains well supported
Alpha-beta specificity is supported by CD3/TCR/activation terms rather than direct TRAC/TRBC marker evidence
Does not place the GZMK+ effector-memory state into the primary label

strengths: Correctly identifies the broad T-cell lineage using CD3D, CD3G, CD2, and TCR-related signals
weaknesses: Under-specified: fails to reflect the strong CD8A/CD8B and cytotoxic granzyme/NKG7/GNLY signal
Ranked subtype alternatives (CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell; effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell) are more informative but not the primary call

strengths: Correctly recognizes the dominant cytotoxic program (granzymes, NKG7, GNLY, CST7, CTSW)
Properly excludes NK cells using CD3/CD8 lineage evidence and absence of canonical NK-specific receptors
weaknesses: Omits the CD8-positive lineage component supported by CD8A and CD8B
CL:0000910 is non-hierarchical to and less precise than CL:0000794 for this cluster

supporting: CD8A and CD8B directly support the CD8-positive T-cell lineage added relative to the T-cell ancestor CL:0000084
GZMK, GZMH, GZMA, GZMM, NKG7, GNLY, CST7, CTSW, CCL5 support the cytotoxic effector program
CD3D, CD3G, CD2, TCR signaling, and the observed alpha-beta T cell activation term support the T-cell/alpha-beta lineage
IL7R, S100A4, HOPX, ID2, DUSP2 support the GZMK+ effector-memory-like secondary state
PMID 36703979, 40624003, 38678059, 28005906, 41277843, 36276113, 31554271, 33927693 provide supporting T-cell/cytotoxic literature context
conflicting: NK-associated genes NCR3, GNLY, NKG7, and HCST could suggest an NK/NKT-like interpretation, but CD3D/CD3G/CD8A/CD8B and TCR signaling place them within the CD8+ cytotoxic T-cell program
enrichment_or_literature: Original GO/Reactome/KEGG enrichments (cell killing, granzyme-mediated programmed cell death, cytolytic granule, TCR signaling) support cytotoxic CD8+ T-cell identity

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
